## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 28.06.2026 - 11.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Kaka hindustan gamer_, 11.08.2026, 1/5: "I'm a free user, I delete this app due to paywall because can't work for analyse my weekly tracker & monthly widgets & still the main feature of the app habit tracker is not work because you have to pay for this"
            2. _Sushil Jaiswar_, 14.07.2026, 5/5: "it's totally free guys! you can go for it. this is best habit tracker app for beginner who can't afford expensive premium membership and it will also remind you 👌 you can create multiple habits on it without any expenses like other app 🤝"
            3. _Tanvir Sadid_, 07.07.2026, 5/5: "Very Friendly. But premium subscription are so expensive."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Werbedruck** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Werbedruck.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen werbedruck.
      Review-Fenster: 08.09.2026 - 15.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer spüren Werbedruck. Das signalisiert Monetarisierungsreibung und eine Öffnung für einen saubereren Wettbewerber.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Vishal_, 08.09.2026, 4/5: "Most habit tracker apps today are packed with useless, flashy features designed just to consume your screen time and push more ads. This app is refreshingly simple, straight to the point, and keeps the focus entirely on tracking habits without clutter. The only major missing piece is a home screen widget. Having a 24/7 reminder directly on the screen makes a huge difference — it keeps habits front of mind and prevents the need to open the phone, which often leads to getting distracted by other a"
            2. _Khulicias Mdudo_, 15.09.2026, 5/5: "This app is great it's made planning goals and building better habits easier however there are too many ads .I strongly recommend this"
            3. _Abhijith John Lambert_, 08.09.2026, 5/5: "after so many researchers about a best habit tracker app, I finally found this app. everything is good in this app except ads. But there's a premium subscription plan for blocking ads"
<!--/ir-theme-->
